lines: Severe pain in right big toe after wedding celebration
The patient is a 57-year-old male with established Type 2 diabetes mellitus and Class II obesity who presents with acute foot pain.
He describes the pain as sudden in onset, starting the night before and worsening to the point where he cannot bear weight on his foot.
He reports that he attended a wedding two days ago where he consumed a significant amount of alcohol and had a steak dinner.
